name: Destined Doom
body:
School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.
Target one person
Duration permanent
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell lets you influence the target’s ultimate fate. You designate a specific person, a type of weapon, a type of creature (whether animal or monster), or a location. The targeted individual is at –3 AC against all attacks by the specified person, weapon, or creature, or in the specified location. He also takes an additional 1d6 points of damage from each successful attack by that doom or in that location.
